intro.description: Welcome: why your move is only half of the move, and what you will be able to do.

lesson1.description: Lesson 3.1: communication is a chain of responses, and best responses depend on the other player.

lesson5.description: Lesson 3.5: feedback loops, the escalation trap and the limits of prediction.
